spec_case: issue #600 item 2 (a JSON-escaped secret in an http error body)
description: A server echoes a `{secret: api}` value inside its JSON error body with a backslash before a literal slash, which a raw-text-only scrub never matches; the parsed `error` field this engine reads it from, and the raw body under `meta.raw.body`, both still have it replaced with `[secret:api]`. The value is a fake-credential marker, so the harness's own blanket check proves it reaches no --out, --events, --live-state, stdout or stderr.
